_comment: Deliberate exceptions for scripts/check-docs-accuracy.mjs. Every entry needs a reason — an unexplained entry is how a checker stops catching things.

_reasons.schematic names: registerX/subscribeX/getX* and the Gadget* family are invented stand-ins in walkthroughs (registration-seams.md, state-and-stores.md, support-type-extension.md), not real symbols.
_reasons.external symbols: n_coords is a field of the third-party LYS format; version_comparator is a tauri-plugin-updater API.
_reasons.deliberately removed: kerf_mm is named in organic-cut-surface-redesign.md precisely to record that it is gone.
_reasons.aspirational: page-tsx-refactor-handoff.md is a refactor plan; its symbols name extractions not yet made. packageManager is a package.json key npm has not adopted here.
_reasons.generated at build time: the paths are produced by scripts/generate-plugin-registry.mjs and are gitignored (**/generated*), so they are absent from a clean checkout.
_reasons.proposed, not built: island_replay is the name ADR-0025 proposes for a capability not yet folded in; pushToast is named in notifications.md precisely to state that no such API exists.

_comment_webkit_symbols: The eight WebKit/JavaScriptCore internals above (javascript_gc_object_count through operationMapHash) are cited by docs/dev/performance-debugging.md as they appear in `sample` output and WebKit's own logs. They belong to the platform, not to this codebase, and will never be found here.
